text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin). There is mild metabolic acidosis (low CO₂), mild monocytosis, eosinophilia, and basophilia. INR is slightly elevated. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection or bone marrow suppression, and impaired oxygenation. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
